focus_areas: Connection points of railing posts to stairs
Consistency of reflection on metal surfaces
Geometric linearity of the handrail vs. stair edge
Distinction between optical lens distortion and AI warping
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'perspective_distortion' artifact. Determine if the curvature of the building and stairs is consistent with a single-point wide-angle lens projection or if there are conflicting vanishing points that suggest AI generation. Scrutinize the base of the metal posts; real-world outdoor rails usually have visible flange plates or bolts, whereas AI often blends them smoothly into the surface.
image_description: A low-angle, wide-lens shot looking up a set of outdoor concrete stairs. The primary subject is a tubular metal handrail (bannister) running diagonally from the bottom left to the center right. The rail is supported by vertical metal posts attached directly to the side of the stair stringer. In the background, there is a tall white building with balconies against a deep blue sky. Three people are sitting on the steps in the upper left corner.

expert_testimonies.reason: To verify if the railing maintains consistent distance from the stairs and if the depth progression of the steps is logical despite the wide-angle distortion.
To confirm the object is classified as a bannister/handrail and not just generic 'stairs' or 'pole'.
